input.quote: 10.8 Headings; Counterparts. The section headings in this Agreement are for reference purposes only and shall not define, limit or affect the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no limitation-of-liability, aggregate-cap or consequential-damages provision anywhere: Section 9 (Warranties) is limited to corporate authority representations and the Globix acknowledgement, Section 10 (General Provisions) ends with notices, no joint venture, assignment, waiver, governing law, severability, survival, entire agreement and headings, and no liability, damages or cap language appears in Sections 1-8 either. Both Parties are therefore exposed to unlimited liability, including the Company for consequential damages arising from HDI's hosted Site. We insert a single mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000 with a mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP, and confirmation that the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages. Placed as new Section 10.9, it survives for two years under the existing Section 10.7 survival provision.

proposal.summary: Insert mutual liability cap with standard uncapped carve-outs
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no limitation of liability, so we add a mutual cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees and USD 1,000,000 with a mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages. Breach of confidentiality, data protection and security obligations, indemnification obligations, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP sit outside the cap, and the Company's payment obligations are not capped damages; our fallback is a mutual twelve-month fee cap with carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.

ops.text: 10.9 Limitation of Liability. Except for Excluded Claims, neither Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim and (b) One Million Dollars ($1,000,000), and neither Party shall be liable for any indirect or consequential damages. The Company's obligations to pay amounts due under this Agreement shall not be considered damages subject to such cap. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is the greater of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000.
The exclusion of indirect and consequential damages applies mutually to both parties.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
Breach of data protection and security obligations is uncapped.
Infringement of the other party's intellectual property is uncapped.
Customer payment obligations are excluded from damages subject to the cap.
